```json
{
  "tests": [
    {
      "name": "Happy path with files",
      "given": "files: [file1.txt, file2.txt], stdin: empty",
      "expect": "strings: [content1, content2], err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Happy path with stdin",
      "given": "files: [], stdin: 'hello world'",
      "expect": "strings: [hello world], err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Empty files and stdin",
      "given": "files: [], stdin: ''",
      "expect": "strings: [], err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "boundary"
    },
    {
      "name": "File reading fails",
      "given": "files: [nonexistent.txt], stdin: empty",
      "expect": "strings: nil, err: error",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "error:1"
    },
    {
      "name": "Files and stdin combined",
      "given": "files: [file1.txt], stdin: 'extra'",
      "expect": "strings: [content1, extra], err: nil",
      "polarity": "success",
      "covers": "happy"
    },
    {
      "name": "Nil stdin",
      "given": "files: [], stdin: nil",
      "expect": "strings: nil, err: error",
      "polarity": "negative",
      "covers": "input:stdin"
    }
  ]
}
```

```go
package cli

import (
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type errorReader struct{}

func (e errorReader) Read(p []byte) (n int, err error) {
	return 0, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF
}

func TestReadInputs(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name        string
		files       []string
		stdin       func() io.Reader
		wantStrings []string
		wantErr     bool
	}{
		{
			name: "Happy path with files",
			files: func() []string {
				tmpDir := t.TempDir()
				f1 := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "file1.txt")
				f2 := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "file2.txt")
				os.WriteFile(f1, []byte("content1"), 0644)
				os.WriteFile(f2, []byte("content2"), 0644)
				return []string{f1, f2}
			}(),
			stdin:       func() io.Reader { return strings.NewReader("") },
			wantStrings: []string{"content1", "content2"},
			wantErr:     false,
		},
		{
			name:        "Happy path with stdin",
			files:       []string{},
			stdin:       func() io.Reader { return strings.NewReader("hello world") },
			wantStrings: []string{"hello world"},
			wantErr:     false,
		},
		{
			name:        "Empty files and stdin",
			files:       []string{},
			stdin:       func() io.Reader { return strings.NewReader("") },
			wantStrings: []string{},
			wantErr:     false,
		},
		{
			name:        "File reading fails",
			files:       []string{"nonexistent.txt"},
			stdin:       func() io.Reader { return strings.NewReader("") },
			wantStrings: nil,
			wantErr:     true,
		},
		{
			name: "Files and stdin combined",
			files: func() []string {
				tmpDir := t.TempDir()
				f1 := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "file1.txt")
				os.WriteFile(f1, []byte("content1"), 0644)
				return []string{f1}
			}(),
			stdin:       func() io.Reader { return strings.NewReader("extra") },
			wantStrings: []string{"content1", "extra"},
			wantErr:     false,
		},
		{
			name:       "Nil stdin",
			files:      []string{},
			stdin:      func() io.Reader { return nil },
			wantStrings: nil,
			wantErr:    true,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			gotStrings, err := readInputs(tt.files, tt.stdin())
			if (err != nil) != tt.wantErr {
				t.Errorf("readInputs() error = %v, wantErr %v", err, tt.wantErr)
				return
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(gotStrings, tt.wantStrings) {
				t.Errorf("readInputs() gotStrings = %v, want %v", gotStrings, tt.wantStrings)
			}
		})
	}
}

func BenchmarkReadInputs(b *testing.B) {
	tmpDir := b.TempDir()
	f1 := filepath.Join(tmpDir, "file1.txt")
	os.WriteFile(f1, []byte("content1"), 0644)

	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		_, _ = readInputs([]string{f1}, strings.NewReader("extra"))
	}
}
```
